dct_description_sm:
Historical dataset of line geometry features representing the locations of MTA bus routes within the City of Baltimore as of 2022. For current MTA bus routes data, please visit the State of Maryland's iMAP open data portal: https://data.imap.maryland.gov/datasets/maryland::maryland-transit-mta-bus-lines-1/about

Maryland Transit Administration Transit Lines including Local Bus, Light Rail, Metro, MARC & Commuter Bus. Also includes bus routes from Central Maryland Regional Transit, Howard Transit, Frederick Transit, Annapolis Transit, Charm City Circulator and BWI Airport.
